proposals.name: The Open Supra
proposals.why: Our panel is a table every guardian shares, and each toast we raise credits the work that came before, which is what an open supra means.

proposals.name: Those Who Came Before
proposals.why: Every design we judge stands on earlier work, and this name says so before the first decision is made.

proposals.name: Shoulders of Giants
proposals.why: Good work stands on others' shoulders, and a panel named for that stance keeps the credit in plain view for every choice it makes.
